gaps.title: Parser: HSP101 — DOT/ARROW syntax fails in 13 examples
gaps.description: 13 .hs example files fail with HSP101: Unexpected token DOT or ARROW in property blocks. Affected: agents/guard-patrol.hs, agents/iot-sensor-pipeline.hs, novel-use-cases/04..06. Examples use older method-call syntax not supported by current parser.

gaps.title: Parser: HSP001 — colon/on_error syntax fails in 15 examples
gaps.description: 15 .hs files fail with HSP001: Unexpected token COLON or ON_ERROR. Affected: ai-agent.hs, autonomous-ecosystems/* (4 files), cryptography/secure-channel-setup.hs, enterprise/tenant-provisioning.hs. Examples use key:value and on_error blocks not in current grammar.

gaps.title: Parser: HSP201 — numeric @2d directive fails in 2 examples
gaps.description: 2 .hs files (general/dashboard.hs, general/login-form.hs) fail with HSP201: Expected directive name, got NUMBER. @2d syntax not recognized. Parser expects alphabetic directive names.

gaps.title: Parser: HSP300 — PIPE operator in expression fails in 1 example
gaps.description: pipelines/knowledge-compressor.hs fails with HSP300: Unexpected PIPE token in expression. Pipeline chaining via | operator not supported in current grammar.
